timbre_variation.method: mean pairwise MFCC centroid distance across segments

dimensions.architectural_proposal: Stack more distinct floor episodes and change the module more often along the public sequence.
Open the section: more headroom and deeper shading where the music releases, compression where it does not.
Tighten the structural bay and the tertiary framing rhythm within the declared span limits.
Run the plate past its supports and round the end rather than cutting it; keep more of the floor for continuous routes.
Fix the envelope module and the tertiary rhythms -- mullion spacing, spandrel band, guard posts -- to a tighter, more regular cadence.
Let the upper plates depart from the lower ones: step the plan back and rotate each level against the one below.
Make one structural order dominate: a deeper roof truss, a taller open ground level, a larger entry gesture.
Break the stack: punch atrium voids through the plates and strip the envelope from whole levels to make terraces.

Separate the orders so each reads on its own: push the envelope further outboard of the frame, add screen and shading layers, express more braced bays. This is a layering proxy, not a count of voices.

A timbral position, bright and percussive against dark and sustained. It proposes a weighting between a light glazed envelope and a heavier panelled one, and a fin depth to match. It is not a genre label, it never selects a facade grammar, and a human must accept the weighting.

dimensions.label: Tempo of change
dimensions.proposal: Stack more distinct floor episodes and change the module more often along the public sequence.

datums.label: occupied levels
datums.reason: A faster rate of change stacks more distinct occupied floor episodes.

dimensions.note: Fully measured and fully free to move, but it reaches only a small part of the model.

dimensions.label: Tension and release
dimensions.proposal: Open the section: more headroom and deeper shading where the music releases, compression where it does not.

datums.label: floor to floor
datums.reason: Released passages get more headroom; compressed ones less.

datums.label: shading rows
datums.reason: Tension multiplies the south shading comb.

datums.label: shading depth
datums.reason: Release deepens the shading projection and the shadow it throws.

dimensions.note: Directly measured, free to cross its declared range, and reaching a substantial part of the model.

dimensions.label: Density
dimensions.proposal: Tighten the structural bay and the tertiary framing rhythm within the declared span limits.

datums.label: bay, long axis
datums.reason: Denser music tightens the primary structural bay.

datums.label: bay, short axis
datums.reason: The secondary direction follows the same density, one step wider.

datums.label: joist spacing
datums.reason: Density sets the tertiary framing rhythm read from below.

datums.label: transom rows
datums.reason: Density subdivides each storey of the curtain wall.

dimensions.note: Directly measured, free to cross its declared range, and reaching a substantial part of the model.

dimensions.label: Continuity
dimensions.proposal: Run the plate past its supports and round the end rather than cutting it; keep more of the floor for continuous routes.

datums.label: plate cantilever
datums.reason: Continuous passages push the floor plate past its supports. The driving dimension is known at 0.72 confidence, so the datum travels only 96% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: apse radius
datums.reason: Continuity rounds the end of the plate instead of cutting it. The driving dimension is known at 0.72 confidence, so the datum travels only 96% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: plate kept for routes
datums.reason: Continuity keeps more of the plate for uninterrupted routes. The driving dimension is known at 0.72 confidence, so the datum travels only 96% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: stair width
datums.reason: A continuous public route carries a wider stair. The driving dimension is known at 0.72 confidence, so the datum travels only 96% of its declared range from the midpoint.

dimensions.note: A defensible proxy, not a direct measurement of the thing named. Treat the result as a proposal.

dimensions.label: Repetition

source_features.method: harmonic comb of the chroma+timbre self-similarity lag profile

dimensions.proposal: Fix the envelope module and the tertiary rhythms -- mullion spacing, spandrel band, guard posts -- to a tighter, more regular cadence.

datums.label: mullion module
datums.reason: Repetition fixes the envelope module.

datums.label: spandrel band
datums.reason: A regular piece bands the floor zone tightly and repeatedly.

datums.label: guard post spacing
datums.reason: The guard post rhythm is the finest repeated element in the model.

dimensions.note: Directly measured, free to cross its declared range, and reaching a substantial part of the model.

dimensions.label: Variation

source_features.method: mean pairwise MFCC centroid distance across segments

dimensions.proposal: Let the upper plates depart from the lower ones: step the plan back and rotate each level against the one below.

datums.label: plate step-back
datums.reason: Variation steps the upper plates back from the lower ones.

datums.label: plate rotation
datums.reason: Each level turns against the one below, so the stack is never a simple extrusion.

dimensions.note: Directly measured, free to cross its declared range, and reaching a substantial part of the model.

dimensions.label: Hierarchy
dimensions.proposal: Make one structural order dominate: a deeper roof truss, a taller open ground level, a larger entry gesture.

datums.label: roof truss depth
datums.reason: Hierarchy sets how much the roof structure dominates.

datums.label: truss panels
datums.reason: Hierarchy sets the web rhythm inside the roof truss.

datums.label: open ground level
datums.reason: Hierarchy decides how far the mass lifts off the ground.

datums.label: entry canopy span
datums.reason: A dominant order announces its entrance; a level one does not.

dimensions.note: Directly measured, free to cross its declared range, and reaching a substantial part of the model.

dimensions.label: Interruption
dimensions.proposal: Break the stack: punch atrium voids through the plates and strip the envelope from whole levels to make terraces.

datums.label: atrium voids
datums.reason: Interruption punches atrium voids through the stack. The driving dimension is known at 0.74 confidence, so the datum travels only 99% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: void scale
datums.reason: A harder break opens a larger hole in the plate. The driving dimension is known at 0.74 confidence, so the datum travels only 99% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: terrace levels
datums.reason: A break strips the envelope from a whole level and makes it a terrace. The driving dimension is known at 0.74 confidence, so the datum travels only 99% of its declared range from the midpoint.

dimensions.note: Measured, but not confidently enough to cross its full range. It moves the design within a narrowed band.

dimensions.label: Polyphony
dimensions.proposal: Separate the orders so each reads on its own: push the envelope further outboard of the frame, add screen and shading layers, express more braced bays. This is a layering proxy, not a count of voices.

datums.label: envelope stand-off
datums.reason: Independent voices need separation: the envelope stands off the frame so both read. The driving dimension is known at 0.55 confidence, so the datum travels only 73% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: envelope layers
datums.reason: Glazing, then a screen, then a shading comb: one readable layer per voice. The driving dimension is known at 0.55 confidence, so the datum travels only 73% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: braced bays
datums.reason: More independent lines means the lateral system is expressed more often. The driving dimension is known at 0.55 confidence, so the datum travels only 73% of its declared range from the midpoint.

dimensions.note: A defensible proxy, not a direct measurement of the thing named. Treat the result as a proposal.

dimensions.label: Timbral position
dimensions.proposal: A timbral position, bright and percussive against dark and sustained. It proposes a weighting between a light glazed envelope and a heavier panelled one, and a fin depth to match. It is not a genre label, it never selects a facade grammar, and a human must accept the weighting.

datums.label: opaque share
datums.reason: A timbral position between a heavy panelled envelope and a light glazed one. Proposed only; a human accepts the weighting. The driving dimension is known at 0.35 confidence, so the datum travels only 47% of its declared range from the midpoint.

datums.label: fin depth
datums.reason: The same timbral position sets how far the mullion projects and how hard the elevation reads. The driving dimension is known at 0.35 confidence, so the datum travels only 47% of its declared range from the midpoint.

dimensions.note: Inferred from a proxy and clamped hard. It nudges the design; it must not be presented as having shaped it.

constants.label: slab thickness
constants.reason: Composite deck and topping depth for the selected steel frame.

constants.label: plate edge
constants.reason: Visible plate edge: slab plus edge beam.

constants.label: stair riser
constants.reason: Stair riser inside the accessible range; sets every flight division.

constants.label: guard height
constants.reason: Guard height; also the primary scale anchor in the model.

constants.label: scale figure
constants.reason: Scale figure. Not architecture, but the reason the rest reads as architecture.

limitations: 85% of datums are score-driven; the rest are declared design fixtures waiting on .
Program: 2842 m2 delivered against 2787 m2 briefed (102%); every space fits.
Frame sized for Stages at 7.18 kPa, the heaviest allocated room; the column stack sums the real per-level loads.
Lift shaft geometry does not provide lift doors or equipment. Occupied levels without a continuous shaft: .

Stair and lift openings remove slab and ceiling material. Opening-edge framing and structural member rerouting remain unresolved; existing beams are retained for collision review, not silently deleted.
Accessible approach: 8 ramp runs at 1:12 with 9 landings, checked against 405.2 running slope not steeper than 1:12; 405.5 clear width 915 mm minimum; 405.6 rise 760 mm maximum per run.
Gravity only. No wind, seismic, snow, or notional lateral load.
Roof truss, envelope, circulation, and furniture members are dimensioned by architectural convention; only column, girder, and joist carry a section a load calculation governed.

Connection topology is explicit and graph-checked; connection plates, bolts, welds, anchors, fasteners and capacities are not designed. Fire protection, camber, vibration and lateral-torsional buckling remain unchecked. Every element remains professional_review_required.

System and grammar: STR-SYS-STEEL-FRAME with FCD-05-HIGH-TECH. The grammar the music asked for was admissible; its preferred frame was not, so the nearest admissible frame carries it. Reasoning: mass 0.19 < 0.62: the elevation is a framed or layered skin; layering 0.49 < 0.60: one skin does the work; regularity 0.51 in between: neither a strict grid nor a composed one, so the frame itself is left to read as the elevation; expression 0.92 >= 0.58: material that transforms between sections asks for a frame that shows how it is joined.
The music preferred FCD-05-HIGH-TECH on STR-SYS-GLULAM-POST-BEAM; the screen overruled it. STR-SYS-GLULAM-POST-BEAM did not survive the screen

Six of the ten structural systems are not emitted by this compiler and were screened out rather than approximated: STR-SYS-CABLE-NET-HYBRID (The same form-finding problem as the membrane, plus a mast and anchor layout that no datum in this set describes); STR-SYS-LIGHT-WOOD-FRAME (Stud walls at 400 mm centres are a wall assembly, not a frame of discrete members; the emitter would have to model sheathing diaphragms for the result to mean anything); STR-SYS-RC-SHELL (Elements index into surface parameters (SHL-RIB-U012), not levels); STR-SYS-STEEL-SPACE-FRAME-SHELL (A space frame follows a curved surface subdivision; the level lattice cannot place its nodes); STR-SYS-TENSILE-MEMBRANE (Form is found by relaxation under prestress, not laid out on a grid); STR-SYS-TIMBER-GRIDSHELL (A doubly-curved lath grid set out by geodesic curves on a surface; there is no level lattice to index into).

axes.reason: A wide dynamic range asks the elevation to hold a strong contrast between solid and void, and a discontinuous piece asks it to be broken rather than uniform. Both push toward wall over glass. The timbral reading nudges this by at most 0.12 and never selects on its own.
Independent simultaneous strands ask to be read separately, which on an elevation means a second structure standing off the first rather than one skin doing all the work.
Material that returns on a fixed period asks for a strict module; material that never returns asks for a composed elevation.
A piece with one dominant event wants one dominant event on the facade; an even piece wants an even field.

unbuildable_systems.STR-SYS-LIGHT-WOOD-FRAME: Stud walls at 400 mm centres are a wall assembly, not a frame of discrete members; the emitter would have to model sheathing diaphragms for the result to mean anything. Not built.
unbuildable_systems.STR-SYS-RC-SHELL: Elements index into surface parameters (SHL-RIB-U012), not levels. Needs a thrust-network skeleton this compiler does not have.
unbuildable_systems.STR-SYS-TIMBER-GRIDSHELL: A doubly-curved lath grid set out by geodesic curves on a surface; there is no level lattice to index into.
unbuildable_systems.STR-SYS-TENSILE-MEMBRANE: Form is found by relaxation under prestress, not laid out on a grid. Emitting one from these datums would be a drawing, not a model.
unbuildable_systems.STR-SYS-CABLE-NET-HYBRID: The same form-finding problem as the membrane, plus a mast and anchor layout that no datum in this set describes.
unbuildable_systems.STR-SYS-STEEL-SPACE-FRAME-SHELL: A space frame follows a curved surface subdivision; the level lattice cannot place its nodes.

selection.note: The grammar the music asked for was admissible; its preferred frame was not, so the nearest admissible frame carries it. Reasoning: mass 0.19 < 0.62: the elevation is a framed or layered skin; layering 0.49 < 0.60: one skin does the work; regularity 0.51 in between: neither a strict grid nor a composed one, so the frame itself is left to read as the elevation; expression 0.92 >= 0.58: material that transforms between sections asks for a frame that shows how it is joined.

accent_red.reason: The one saturated colour, for what a building marks out: handrails, doors.

concrete.reason: Cast concrete as struck, without a finish over it.

concrete_light.reason: The lighter cast surface: slabs and podium.

frame_dark.reason: Curtain-wall framing, which is dark on almost every building of this type.

furn.reason: Loose furniture, deliberately quiet against the fabric.

glass.reason: Vision glass. Transmission is what makes it glass rather than a pale panel.

ground_light.reason: The made surface outside the building.

prog_public.reason: Public program, shown as a diagram rather than as a built surface.

steel_dark.reason: Dark steel: bracing and the members meant to read as structure.

steel_light.reason: Lighter steel for secondary and screen members.

steel_white.reason: Painted structural steel, the frame default.

timber.reason: Mass timber. A timber frame that renders as white steel loses the one cue that says which material was selected.

white.reason: The general light surface: linings, treads, soffits.

white_soft.reason: A half-tone below white, so two adjacent surfaces read apart.

location.rationale: The stand-in when no provider names a site. Chosen because it exercises a high-seismic, low-snow case rather than because the building belongs there.

basic_wind_speed_ms.basis: ASCE 7-16 Figure 26.5-1B basic wind speed for Risk Category II at Los Angeles, California, recalled rather than read from the map.

wind_exposure_category.basis: ASCE 7-16 26.7.3 surface roughness category; an urban site is normally B.

topographic_factor_kzt.basis: ASCE 7-16 26.8.2. Kzt is 1.0 on level terrain; a hill or escarpment needs the real topography.

mapped_ss.basis: ASCE 7-16 Figure 22-1 mapped short-period acceleration at Los Angeles, California, recalled rather than read from the USGS tool.

mapped_s1.basis: ASCE 7-16 Figure 22-2 mapped one-second acceleration at Los Angeles, California, recalled rather than read.

site_class.basis: ASCE 7-16 Table 20.3-1. Site Class D is the default where no geotechnical report exists, which is the case here.

seismic_design_category.basis: ASCE 7-16 Tables 11.6-1 and 11.6-2, from Ss, S1 and the risk category.

ground_snow_kpa.basis: ASCE 7-16 Figure 7.2-1 ground snow load at Los Angeles, California, recalled rather than read.

snow_exposure_ce.basis: ASCE 7-16 Table 7.3-1, partially exposed roof in Terrain Category B.

thermal_factor_ct.basis: ASCE 7-16 Table 7.3-2 for a heated building.

adopted_building_code.basis: The edition and amendments the jurisdiction has adopted, which is the field a plan checker looks at first.

adopted_load_standard.basis: The load standard the adopted code references.

risk_category.basis: IBC Table 1604.5. Risk Category II covers ordinary assembly and business occupancies; an assembly space over 300 people can push a building to III.

sprinklered.basis: Assumed sprinklered throughout, which every egress width and travel distance in `life_safety.py` depends on. Turning it off changes them.

snow.basis: 0.7 * Ce 1.0 * Ct 1.0 * Is 1.0 * pg 0.0 kPa. Drift, sliding and unbalanced cases are not computed.

wind.basis: q 894 Pa * G 0.85 * (Cp windward 0.8 - Cp leeward -0.5) over a 65.9 x 26.6 m face. No internal pressure, no torsional case.

seismic.basis: Cs 0.3590 = SDS 1.167 / (R 3.25 / Ie 1.0), with the 12.8-5 floor applied, on a seismic weight of 73224 kN. Fa 1.00 and Fv 1.70 for Site Class D. Vertical distribution, drift and redundancy are not computed.

limitations: 85% of datums are score-driven; the rest are declared design fixtures waiting on .
Program: 2842 m2 delivered against 2787 m2 briefed (102%); every space fits.
Frame sized for Stages at 7.18 kPa, the heaviest allocated room; the column stack sums the real per-level loads.
Lift shaft geometry does not provide lift doors or equipment. Occupied levels without a continuous shaft: .

Stair and lift openings remove slab and ceiling material. Opening-edge framing and structural member rerouting remain unresolved; existing beams are retained for collision review, not silently deleted.
Accessible approach: 8 ramp runs at 1:12 with 9 landings, checked against 405.2 running slope not steeper than 1:12; 405.5 clear width 915 mm minimum; 405.6 rise 760 mm maximum per run.
Gravity only. No wind, seismic, snow, or notional lateral load.
Roof truss, envelope, circulation, and furniture members are dimensioned by architectural convention; only column, girder, and joist carry a section a load calculation governed.

Connection topology is explicit and graph-checked; connection plates, bolts, welds, anchors, fasteners and capacities are not designed. Fire protection, camber, vibration and lateral-torsional buckling remain unchecked. Every element remains professional_review_required.

System and grammar: STR-SYS-STEEL-FRAME with FCD-05-HIGH-TECH. The grammar the music asked for was admissible; its preferred frame was not, so the nearest admissible frame carries it. Reasoning: mass 0.19 < 0.62: the elevation is a framed or layered skin; layering 0.49 < 0.60: one skin does the work; regularity 0.51 in between: neither a strict grid nor a composed one, so the frame itself is left to read as the elevation; expression 0.92 >= 0.58: material that transforms between sections asks for a frame that shows how it is joined.
The music preferred FCD-05-HIGH-TECH on STR-SYS-GLULAM-POST-BEAM; the screen overruled it. STR-SYS-GLULAM-POST-BEAM did not survive the screen

Six of the ten structural systems are not emitted by this compiler and were screened out rather than approximated: STR-SYS-CABLE-NET-HYBRID (The same form-finding problem as the membrane, plus a mast and anchor layout that no datum in this set describes); STR-SYS-LIGHT-WOOD-FRAME (Stud walls at 400 mm centres are a wall assembly, not a frame of discrete members; the emitter would have to model sheathing diaphragms for the result to mean anything); STR-SYS-RC-SHELL (Elements index into surface parameters (SHL-RIB-U012), not levels); STR-SYS-STEEL-SPACE-FRAME-SHELL (A space frame follows a curved surface subdivision; the level lattice cannot place its nodes); STR-SYS-TENSILE-MEMBRANE (Form is found by relaxation under prestress, not laid out on a grid); STR-SYS-TIMBER-GRIDSHELL (A doubly-curved lath grid set out by geodesic curves on a surface; there is no level lattice to index into).
